correctness.rationale: The current infected equations give a rank-one new-infection matrix with entries containing the squared compliant mixing factor and a transfer matrix containing the actual noncompliance transmission rate \(q=\mu^*-\mu\). value.rationale: The mismatch can move the reproduction number across one and reverse a disease-free stability prediction at a simple exact admissible parameter point. Because the paper uses this threshold to interpret when controls place the system in a stable disease-free regime, correcting the formula changes a qualitative scientific conclusion rather than a cosmetic algebraic detail.
